red_team.case_for_morning: The FT news mostly confirms what the morning priced: de Cos is the agreed choice and capitals seek a consolation post for Knot (Expansión had reported his ESM interest on 21 Nov). The binding risk is timing: Costa's letter gives Thursday's Euro Summit to economic analyses and thanks to Lagarde, with conclusions on Friday; Knot has not withdrawn, an ESM deal needs 80% of capital, and no source confirms the ambassadors adopted the recommendation. Leaders could endorse him but let Costa announce it at Friday's wrap-up.
red_team.case_for_larger: The FT is the first report that names Thursday for the leaders' backing, inside a fixed sequence with a Wednesday ambassadors' recommendation, so the decision would be pre-cooked. Costa's letter seeks a timely decision; the Thursday 10:00 Euro Summit with Lagarde is the natural slot; the package has a qualified majority, so the Dutch cannot block; Costa usually posts top-job agreements at once.
red_team.verdict: The case for the morning figure is somewhat stronger, on timing only: the Thursday line is second-hand and its first step is unconfirmed. 0.55-0.60 is defensible; the plain combination gives 0.60 and stands; nothing above 0.65 is supported. Not sent back: it rests on no fact the forecasters did not weigh.
